text_block_list.text:
The title of the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
something to be seized as a top-class 
stayer—

However, to do that, she would have to 
defeat "her"— who had grown terrifyingly 
strong.

TM Opera O. She had completely transformed 
in her Senior year, and together with 
Narita Top Road, they trained relentlessly 
to overcome her.

She could shine brighter than anyone...! 
Narita Top Road, the hardest worker in 
whom she placed all her faith, stepped up 
to challenge the awakened Overlord!
